_comment_top: MCP hooks configuration template for harness agents. Each harness (jcode, codex, forge) has its own preferred location and schema; see _comment_install_paths below.
_comment_version: v1.1 — $CLAUDE_TOOL_INPUT is JSON-encoded; use jq to inspect (2026-10-13, instinct shared-integration-kit).
_comment_license: Same as parent repo (PhenoShared — operator-confirmed MIT/Apache dual).

hooks.command: jq -r 'tostring' "$CLAUDE_TOOL_INPUT" 2>/dev/null | grep -qE 'gh repo delete|git push --force|git push --force-with-lease|git reset --hard|git clean -fd|git branch -D' && { echo '[mcp-hook] BLOCKED destructive command' >&2; exit 2; } || true
hooks._intent: Block destructive git/gh commands. Tool input is JSON; we serialize to a string and grep for the dangerous pattern. `|| true` on the grep is intentional (no match → allow); the explicit exit 2 on a match is what blocks.

hooks.command: jq -r '.file_path // .path // empty' "$CLAUDE_TOOL_INPUT" 2>/dev/null | xargs -I{} echo "[mcp-hook] Pre-edit — file path: {}"
hooks._intent: Log edit operations for audit. Edit/Write/MultiEdit use file_path; apply_patch uses path. jq normalizes the JSON input.

hooks.command: FILE=$(jq -r '.file_path // .path // empty' "$CLAUDE_TOOL_INPUT" 2>/dev/null); if [ -z "$FILE" ] || [ ! -f "$FILE" ]; then exit 0; fi; case "$FILE" in *.rs) if command -v rustfmt >/dev/null 2>&1; then rustfmt --check "$FILE" || rustfmt "$FILE"; fi ;; *.py) if command -v ruff >/dev/null 2>&1; then ruff format --check "$FILE" || ruff format "$FILE"; fi ;; *.ts|*.tsx|*.js|*.jsx|*.mjs|*.cjs) if command -v prettier >/dev/null 2>&1; then prettier --check "$FILE" || prettier --write "$FILE"; elif command -v npx >/dev/null 2>&1; then npx --no-install prettier --check "$FILE" || npx --no-install prettier --write "$FILE"; fi ;; *) exit 0 ;; esac
hooks._intent: Run a fast, file-scoped formatter pass against the just-edited file (not the full lefthook pre-commit suite). The full suite can run on the next commit. Failures are NOT auto-fixed when --check fails; we attempt the formatter but never block. To gate, run lefthook pre-commit separately.

hooks.command: if [ "$(uname -s)" = "Darwin" ]; then osascript -e 'display notification "Agent event" with title "jcode" subtitle "'"$CLAUDE_NOTIFICATION_TYPE"'"' 2>/dev/null; elif command -v notify-send >/dev/null 2>&1; then notify-send "jcode" "Agent event: $CLAUDE_NOTIFICATION_TYPE"; else echo "[mcp-hook] notification: $CLAUDE_NOTIFICATION_TYPE"; fi
hooks._intent: Desktop notification on harness events. macOS uses osascript; Linux uses notify-send; otherwise log to stdout.

_comment_variables.$CLAUDE_TOOL_INPUT: Tool input as a JSON-encoded string. Use `jq -r '...' "$CLAUDE_TOOL_INPUT"` to inspect — do not pattern-match the raw string.
_comment_variables.$CLAUDE_NOTIFICATION_TYPE: Type of harness notification (auth, permission_prompt, idle, etc.).
_comment_variables._note: Variable names are conventions; each harness may use different names. Test before relying on them.
